items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses being a 'master Mason' (a member of the Freemasons fraternity), not a person named Mason. No individual named 'Mason' is mentioned or described in the transcript.

ctx.x: never forget, this guy had a pool hall and he was our teacher. His name was Person, he played some guitar, years before that, and I'd go by the pool hall and study and I'd study at home and that's how I became a master Mason. Sabby Lewis and I went in together.
What first got your interest in that? Did you have a friend who was a Mason?

No. You know how you hear things, you know, that if you're a Mason it's good fellowship and you meet some fine men, you know what I mean, upstanding men. I didn't understand all of it but it attracted me because of the ritual and etcetera, etcetera. And it would help you...when you're a musician out on the road, because you're meeting all different kinds of people all the time. And it's good for your public relations. In other words, it would just show me a different facet of life, you know, that attracted me. So…
